paragraph.text:
1.27.35. При определении затрат на устройство покрытий толщиной 4 см из горячих асфальтобетонных смесей с применением норм табл. с 27-06-029 по 27-06-032 норма расхода асфальтобетонной смеси принимается на основании проектных данных. В случае отсутствия проектных данных норма расхода асфальтобетонной смеси принимается по приложению 27.1.
При применении щебёночно-мастичных асфальтобетонных смесей укладка определяется по нормам 27-06-029-01, 27-06-030-01, 27-06-031-01, 27-06-031-02, 27-06-032-01, 27-06-032-02, состав смеси подбирается индивидуально. Норма расхода асфальтобетонной смеси принимается на основании проектных данных. В случае отсутствия проектных данных норма расхода асфальтобетонной смеси принимается по приложению 27.1.
При определении затрат на устройство асфальтобетонного лотка вдоль кромки проезжей части с применением норм 27-06-030-02, 27-06-069-01 норма расхода асфальтобетонной смеси принимается на основании проектных данных.

exists: Amended paragraph1.27.35 and full appendix27.1 exist in local saved original PDF; appendix fallback is explicitly allowed when project consumption data are absent.
VOR notes explicitly name appendix27.1 and density branch2.7–2.9; these are declared estimating assumptions, not laboratory evidence about finished asphalt.
The table header is maximum density of STONE MATERIALS, not bulk density of the asphalt mixture.
not_delivered: linked-ten-v15 final reviews23/38/60/71 did not contain the amended fallback or exact appendix table; they sought unrelated preparation norms and relied on resource П.
source-three-v16/71 DID receive the exact table and correctly found the arithmetic discrepancy. Thus there is no universal current delivery-absence claim.
still_missing: Independent support or accepted explicit estimating-basis authority for the selected maximum stone-material density branch >2.7≤2.9; VOR declaration alone does not verify that property.
Review whether project data already establish consumption, before taking the no-project-consumption fallback. Geometry/material designation alone is not a numerical consumption rate.
For position38 selected parent norm27-07-006 differs from table range27-06-029..032 listed in paragraph1.27.35; direct extension needs its own applicable provision.
Independent parent geometry and norm applicability remain separate checks.
not_required_by_this_clause: No laboratory testing procedure or mandatory certificate is stipulated by paragraph1.27.35 or appendix27.1; suitable design/material/accepted estimating evidence could justify the density branch.
Do not require finished-mixture density or actual future-batch suitability when checking only the declared estimating-reference/formula claim.
real_conflicts: 11/87: +10 increments of0.5cm above4cm implies9cm; adjacent parent work explicitly says10cm. This must be investigated, not repaired by treating10 as a1cm increment.
limits: Changing the interpretation of a narrow citation/formula claim may resolve that aspect; it cannot confirm unconditional actual consumption or stone density.
At least11 materials share the class, but no evidence supports promising at least7 full-position confirmations.
Original table page states unit т but no area denominator; 1000м2 must be linked to applicable parent norm, not invented in the table quotation.
No internet verification of legal force or subsequent amendments performed.

recommended_next_step: Deliver exact amended clause + full physical table headers/selected row + VOR note together; separate conditional estimating formula, actual density-branch applicability, parent area and thickness, and arithmetic. Keep missing branch authority as needs_facts where required.
